exposure: Intrathecal hyperbaric bupivacaine 0.5% with normal saline
outcome: Time for sensory regression to L1
cohort: Sixty healthy pregnant women of ASA grade II scheduled for elective caesarean section.
finding: The addition of 10mcg of fentanyl to hyperbaric bupivacaine for spinal anaesthesia significantly improved intraoperative anaesthesia, reduced the incidence of nausea and vomiting, prolonged the total duration of analgesia, and reduced the demand for postoperative analgesics.
followup_time: Observations were taken from the start of anaesthesia, every 2 minutes for the first 10 minutes, then at 15 minutes for the first hour, and thereafter at 30-minute intervals until the patient complained of pain.
